text: DSH Review Mode（DSH 网页客户端插件）：为对话提供独立复审。它在会话中提供审核预设，并在右侧注册可展开的复审面板，可选择当前或其他 DSH 会话以及本机 Codex 对话。主要功能包括按用户、整段对话或 AI 回答切换审核侧重点；监控选定对话的新用户消息；整理带原话标记的有限证据；呈现概述、洞察和建议。适合想检查任务是否偏离目标、答案是否有依据的 DSH 用户。需要已安装 Harness，并由其配置复审模型；远程模型会处理所选证据。

DSH Review Mode reviews DSH and local Codex conversations in a side panel. Choose to review the user, whole exchange, or AI response; monitor new user messages and see evidence, insights, and advice. Requires Harness and a configured review model; remote models process selected evidence.
想让 AI 对话结束后，另一个独立视角帮我看看有没有偏离原目标。
能不能把当前 DSH 会话放到侧边面板里复盘，看看回答有没有依据？
我想查看本机 Codex 对话，并得到简短的分析和下一步建议。
让面板在选中的对话出现新消息后自动更新复审结果。
希望能分别检查我说的话、整段交流或 AI 的回答。
I want a separate reviewer to check whether my AI conversation is drifting from its goal.
Show an evidence-based review of a local Codex chat beside my DSH conversation.
Can I monitor a chosen conversation and review it again when a new user message arrives?
DSH Review Mode 的功能「选择复审对象」：在右侧面板选择当前 DSH、其他本机 DSH 会话或 Codex 对话，并可指定审用户、审整段交流或审 AI 回答。
DSH Review Mode 的功能「自动监控」：选定目标后，监控新用户消息并触发复审；面板显示连接、复审中、失败或已有结果等状态。
DSH Review Mode 的功能「证据复审」：宿主从对话中挑选有限的用户、AI 和工具记录，保留可核对的原话标记，并交给独立复审流程。
DSH Review Mode 的功能「洞察与建议」：复审结果按原话、概述、分析和建议组织；面板可展示内容，解析器支持不同数量的分析条目。
DSH Review Mode 使用前须知：本机读取的对话证据会交给 Harness 配置的复审模型；若模型服务在远端，证据会离开本机。

@local/dsh-review-mode README · DSH Review Mode：**An independent second look at your AI conversations.**

**Actively under development / 正在开发中.** This is an experimental community plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), with support for reading local Codex conversations. It is not an official DeepSeek or OpenAI product. The internal package version `2.1.0` identifies the tested development snapshot, not a stable release.

@local/dsh-review-mode README · DSH Review Mode：Version 2.1.0 was exercised through ten user-facing edit/restart/test cycles plus five regression rounds on macOS. It shows concise, expandable insights, isolates review output from the main assistant context, restores the selected target after restart, and lets the new-result notice open the latest review. See [the current implementation contract](CURRENT-IMPLEMENTATION.md) and [iteration evidence](ITERATIONS.md) for technical details. Model judgments still require human checking.

@local/dsh-review-mode README · DSH Review Mode：[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Installation](docs/INSTALLATION.md) · [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) · [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [Roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/hqa-shu/dsh-review-mode/issues/new/choose)

@local/dsh-review-mode README · Why build this?：An AI conversation can keep moving while the original goal gets lost. A confident answer can hide missing evidence. A user can spend an entire session refining a small detail that does not advance the task.

@local/dsh-review-mode README · Why build this?：Review Mode explores a separate reviewer that reads a bounded evidence package and gives concrete feedback in a side panel. It considers **goal drift, excessive focus on a detail, and the reasoning behind choices**, with three perspectives: the user's instructions, the whole conversation, and the AI's responses.

@local/dsh-review-mode README · What is in this prototype?：| Capability | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Conversation selection | Current DSH session, another local DSH session, or a local Codex conversation |
| Independent review | A separate subagent receives prepared evidence instead of inheriting the full parent context |
| Side-panel output | Quotes, a recap, case-specific analysis, and concrete advice |
| Automatic monitoring | A selected conversation is checked for new user messages; polling is separate from model review |
| Evidence budgeting | Prioritized sections, length limits, and explicit notices when evidence is omitted |
| Observable state | Empty, reviewing, failed, and ready states; runtime identity and liveness diagnostics |
| Review discipline | Reviewer tool access is disabled; feedback distinguishes user decisions from agent actions |

@local/dsh-review-mode README · What is in this prototype?：These are implemented mechanisms, not a claim of proven review accuracy or production reliability. See [validation limits](docs/VALIDATION.md).

@local/dsh-review-mode README · A small example：*Synthetic illustration — not a captured model result.*

> **Request:** “Compare two approaches and show the trade-off.”  
> **AI response:** Recommends one approach without presenting the comparison.  
> **Review:** The requested comparison is missing. Ask for one shared criterion, evidence for each approach, and a clear account of what remains uncertain.

flowchart LR
  A[Choose a conversation] --> B[Prepare bounded evidence]
  B --> C[Independent reviewer]
  C --> D[Quotes and recap]

@local/dsh-review-mode README · Try the development snapshot：The initial baseline is **DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 on macOS arm64**, and **Node.js 24+** for the development scripts. Other platforms and newer Harness versions need validation.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/hqa-shu/dsh-review-mode.git
cd dsh-review-mode
node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs
node scripts/check.mjs

@local/dsh-review-mode README · Try the development snapshot：The preparation script reads selected SDK packages from your installed Harness application into this checkout's ignored `node_modules/`. It does not change the application or your profile. For another installation path, pass `--asar /absolute/path/to/app.asar`. The public repository contains this plugin's source, not a copy of the host SDK.

@local/dsh-review-mode README · Try the development snapshot：Next, install the checkout's **absolute directory path** using Harness's **Plugins** page. Restart Harness, create a session with **审核模式**, and choose a target in the review panel. Follow the [complete installation guide](docs/INSTALLATION.md), especially the model-processing notice. A clean-clone installation in another user's environment has not yet been verified.

@local/dsh-review-mode README · Privacy and model processing：**Local log access does not mean local-only inference.** The host reads conversation evidence from local DSH/Codex records and passes the selected evidence to a reviewer using the configured model provider. If that provider runs remotely, the evidence leaves your machine.

@local/dsh-review-mode README · Privacy and model processing：The reviewer has no tools, but the host plugin reads local files and writes caches, diagnostics, and review state. Automatic secret redaction is **not guaranteed**. Use non-sensitive test conversations first; see [data handling](docs/PRIVACY.md).

@local/dsh-review-mode README · Project layout：| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host engine, projection, review dispatch, monitoring and diagnostics |
| `reviewer.js` | Conversation discovery, evidence preparation, shared target state and tools |
| `client.js` | Review panel, target selection and state rendering |
| `remote.js` | Target/query helpers plus retained legacy remote-service code |
| `rubric.js` | Review rubric, output structure, parsing and advice routing |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Harness preset and host-plugin declarations |
| `test/` | Existing regression tests, including synthetic host and UI doubles |
| `scripts/` | SDK preparation, checks and isolated test runner |
| `examples/` | Profile and configuration examples without credentials |

Start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Please remove private conversation content from reports.

Planned work includes a cleaner installation path, broader compatibility checks, stronger data minimization, review-quality evaluation, and more polished onboarding. [Track the roadmap](docs/ROADMAP.md).

section: DSH Review Mode · 审核模式

text:
@local/dsh-review-mode README · 想解决什么问题？：AI 一直在回答，不一定意味着任务一直在前进。对话可能偏离最初目标，把局部细节越磨越细，或者把缺少证据的判断说得很确定。

审核模式尝试把“做事”和“复审”分开：宿主整理有限证据，交给独立上下文的复审 Agent，再把具体分析显示在旁边的面板里。它从**主题漂移、局部纠结、选择是否合理**切入，也区分用户的指令、整段对话和 AI 的回答。

@local/dsh-review-mode README · 当前实现：- 选择当前 DSH 会话、其他 DSH 会话或本机 Codex 对话。
- 在目标出现新的用户消息后触发复审；检测循环与调用模型分开。
- 输出原话、对话概述、具体分析和可执行建议，分析条数随内容变化。
- 控制证据长度，被省略的证据明确标注。
- 显示未开始、复审中、失败和已有结果，提供运行版本与活性诊断。
- 复审员不具备工具权限；宿主负责读盘、整理证据与投递结果。

这些是代码中的机制，**不等于已经证明审核准确、兼容所有版本或达到生产可用**。测试范围和不足见 [VALIDATION.md](docs/VALIDATION.md)。

@local/dsh-review-mode README · 开始使用开发快照：目前基线：macOS arm64、DeepSeek Harness Desktop `0.2.0-rc.2`；开发检查使用 Node.js 24+。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/hqa-shu/dsh-review-mode.git
cd dsh-review-mode
node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs
node scripts/check.mjs

准备脚本仅从已安装的 Harness 读取所需 SDK 包，写入本仓库被忽略的 `node_modules/`。之后在 Harness 的 **Plugins** 页面，通过仓库的绝对路径安装；重启后创建“审核模式”会话，在面板选择目标。完整步骤、配置示例和故障处理见 [安装指南](docs/INSTALLATION.md)。其他人的全新环境安装尚待验证。
@local/dsh-review-mode README · 使用前理解数据流：本机读取日志，**并不代表模型只在本机运行**。选中的证据会交给 Harness 配置的模型供应方；使用远程模型时，证据会离开电脑。当前不保证自动去除密钥或私人信息。先用无敏感信息的测试对话，详见 [PRIVACY.md](docs/PRIVACY.md)。
